titles.romaji: Kidou Senshi Gundam Thunderbolt: BANDIT FLOWER
titles.english: Mobile Suit Gundam Thunderbolt: Bandit Flower
titles.native: 特別編 機動戦士ガンダムサンダーボルト BANDIT FLOWER

description:
Eight months after the One Year War, the Earth Federation attempts to secure and destroy the Psycho Zaku from the hands of a cult called South Seas Alliance.

Note: This is a compilation film recapping the events from the second season.
